info.name: YugabyteDB Aeon REST Clusters API
info.description:
The YugabyteDB Aeon REST API provides programmatic access to YugabyteDB's fully managed cloud database service.

Contact Support:
 Name: Yugabyte Support

request.description: Pauses a running cluster to suspend compute billing while retaining all data and configuration. The cluster can be resumed at any time. Only clusters in the ACTIVE state can be paused.
